invariants: The global state file is opened read-only and Tocode never writes, modifies, or creates any file under ~/.codex.
A project is valid only when selected-project.type == "local", the projectId is registered in local-projects, rootPaths[0] exists, and the path resolves to an existing directory.
Any missing or malformed JSON, wrong type, unregistered id, empty rootPaths, or non-directory root returns "not detected" and falls back to the manual root.
The sync switch is persisted under the UserDefaults key tocode.codexProjectSyncEnabled and defaults to false.
When sync is on, the four manual-root menu actions (读取剪贴板 / 更改目录 / 重置初始目录 / 访达目录初始化) are disabled regardless of whether Codex state can be read.
prohibited_results: Writing or modifying any Codex state under ~/.codex.
Reading Codex internal files other than ~/.codex/.codex-global-state.json, or relying on IPC/AppleScript to discover the project.
Treating a thread working directory as the project root.
Overwriting the manual root when Codex state is unreadable while sync is on.
Keeping the four manual-root actions clickable while sync is on.
